owner.description: Fleet owner/operator brand shown by the public source; not legal ownership certification.

dp_class.description: Explicit published dynamic-positioning class; DP1/DP2/DP3 hyphenated, NMD notation preserved.

source_url.description: HTTPS URL of a retrieved public source.

retrieved_utc.description: UTC retrieval instant of the row primary source; secondary retrievals are in the manifest.

additionalProperties.description: HTTPS URL of a retrieved public source.

field_sources.description: Each non-null factual field maps to the exact source URL in the provenance manifest.

crane_capacity_tonnes.description: Published headline crane lift capacity; combined or individual according to crane_capacity_basis. Not a load chart or topsides-lifting-system capacity.

crane_capacity_basis.description: Combined vessel crane capacity or capacity of one crane, as published.

deck_area_m2.description: Published usable deck area; never calculated from hull dimensions.

bollard_pull_tonnes.description: Published bollard pull in metric tonnes-force.
